open_frontier: SOH-G003 real-rootedness, actual quotient PF3/PF-infinity, SOH-C005 full admissible Weil positivity, and RH remain open. SOH-G021 proves only that the abstract G020 structural package does not imply PF3.

claims.statement: Binary Shannon entropy is uniquely maximal at sigma=1/2, with value ln 2.
Equal-gain normalized two-channel cancellation occurs only at sigma=1/2 and relative phase pi.
The fixed set of K(s)=1-conjugate(s) is Re(s)=1/2.
Entropy deficit from balance equals Bernoulli KL divergence and is positive away from 1/2.
Within the binary-spinor representation, complement symmetry, maximal entropy, spinorial sign and phase-locked cancellation select sigma=1/2.
Eta and zeta have identical zero sets with multiplicity in the open critical strip.
Unequal channel gains shift the cancellation point to |b|^2/(|a|^2+|b|^2).
The native paired theta state satisfies P(K(s)) = X conjugate(P(s)).
The normalized native PhaseNav closure defect equals (Re(s)-1/2)^2.
The continuous paired theta-Mellin detector equals xi(s).
For an involution-fixed finite centred zero fixture, the PhaseNav-Weil matrix reduces to a positive-semidefinite Gram matrix.
Omega(s)=s/(1-s) maps the critical line Re(s)=1/2 to the unit circle.
Omega(K(s))=1/conjugate(Omega(s)) for K(s)=1-conjugate(s).
Re(s)=1/2 if and only if |Omega(s)|=1.
RH is equivalent to every transformed non-trivial zero lying on |Omega|=1.
B=log|Omega| is K-odd; V=B^2 is non-negative and vanishes exactly on Re(s)=1/2.
The Li coordinate z_L(s)=1-1/s equals -1/Omega(s).
z_L(K(s))=1/conjugate(z_L(s)).
With the standard symmetric zero-sum convention, Li coefficients are power sums in z_L(rho).
A reciprocal-conjugate quartet z=R exp(i phi) contributes L_n=4-2(R^n+R^-n)cos(n phi).
The local quartet growth radius is max(R,R^-1)=exp(|B(rho)|).
V(rho)=(log R_script(rho))^2 for the local Li growth radius.
Every off-circle reciprocal-conjugate quartet has a local Li contribution with liminf equal to minus infinity.
An off-axis zero maps to a singularity of the Li generating function inside the unit disk on the corresponding side of the functional symmetry.
Global Li non-negativity lambda_n>=0 for all n is equivalent to RH.
Under the standard admissible Weil setup, full Weil positivity is equivalent to RH.
B=log|Omega| is an additive log-radial coordinate for the prime-shift representation.
Prime arithmetic support occurs at additive shifts plus/minus log n in the screw/Weil representation.
A single positive-weight hinge kernel h_a(t)=(|t|-a)_+ is indefinite; a two-point minor has determinant -a^2/4.
Positivity of von Mangoldt weights alone cannot establish SOH-C005 term by term.
Localized SOH-C005 reduces to non-negativity of the lowest spectral value lambda(a) of the localized arithmetic Weil operator.
For the standard localized Rayleigh domains C_c^infinity(-a,a), lambda(a) is non-increasing as a grows by nested-domain inclusion.
The Gaussian PhaseNav-Weil matrix test has the declared closed Fourier transform under the exp(-2 pi i x r) convention.
Finite spans of translated-scaled Hermite PhaseNav channels are dense in Schwartz space.
The Hermite kernel has the declared closed Fourier transform and Hhat_mn(0)=delta_mn.
Binary complement is conjugate to reciprocal inversion in projective odds coordinates.
The unique positive reciprocal fixed point corresponds to p=1/2.
p=1/2 is the Fisher-Rao geodesic midpoint between the labelled pure states.
The logarithmic prime tail is compactified by z_tail=1/log(x) to a finite interval with a smooth flat endpoint.
Every fixed Hermite entry has the declared upper-incomplete-gamma prime-tail majorant under an explicit monotonicity condition.
Entrywise prime-tail certificates imply a finite-section operator-norm bound and Weyl eigenvalue enclosure.
For every c>0, Q_N=exp(cN) forces the declared coarse Hermite finite-section prime-tail envelope to zero.
The declared primitive K=6 Stage-M forcing landscape for word lengths 1..4 is exactly classified; q=1 is uniquely maximal only for lengths 2 and 3.
A canonical zeta-state map converts every non-trivial zero into equal-gain complementary cancellation.
A theta-kernel, analytic-vector, positivity or reproducing-kernel construction satisfies the canonical bridge requirements.
A self-adjoint operator has spectral determinant proportional to Xi.
Every non-trivial xi zero closes in the canonical self-dual PhaseNav shell.
The complete arithmetic PhaseNav-Weil form is non-negative on the full admissible test family by an independent proof not assuming an RH-equivalent premise.
Inverse-boundary geometry reduces zero closure to the self-dual unit circle/half-layer and admits the holomorphic square quotient.
Historical intermediate quotient identifier; no standalone theorem is promoted under this ID in the integrated canon.
Every zero of the entire quotient F is real; with proved coefficient positivity this is equivalent to RH.
The compactified exact Riemann-kernel weight W is strictly log-concave; prior strict log-concavity of the classical Xi kernel Phi is attributed to Gershon.
The Taylor coefficients of F form a PF2 sequence.
The solid PF3 Toeplitz minor has the exact ratio-curvature reduction M_k; global non-negativity for the actual quotient coefficients remains open.
The half-centered Collatz branch conjugacies are exact; the Uroboros torus exists only after the explicit scale identification u~32u.
The xi scale defect obeys reciprocal antisymmetry and cannot be globally scale-periodic for nontrivial dilation.
The selected five-halving chain is an exact hyperbolic/Mobius translation to the centered half-layer.
On the positive real u-axis the scale defect has the unique sign-changing crossing u=a^-1/2.
The scale defect has the symmetry-forced simple pair u=+/-a^-1/2 exchanged by the Euler half-period; additional complex defect zeros are not excluded.
Riemann reflection and the Euler half-turn factor the canonical negative inverse; the projective operator group is V4.
The G012 projective operators admit the Pauli/SU(2) lift Q8->V4 with kernel {+/-I}.
Only finitely many xi zeros can be paired by canonical negative inversion.
Only finitely many F roots can be paired by J(w)=1/(16w), with the stated involution-orbit classification.
The paired xi and quotient spectra obey q(P_N)=P_J and |P_N|=2|P_J|.
Neither fixed value w=+/-1/4 is a root of F; any remaining paired sets have forced orbit divisibility.
The closed disk |w|<=1/4 is zero-free; consequently P_J=P_N=empty and negative inversion has no zero-to-zero spectral action.
There is a unique R_star>0 with F(R_star)=2F(0), Re F(w)>0 on |w|<=R_star, and the rescaled positive coefficients are exactly normalized.

The canonical rescaling gives a probability law with half its mass at index zero and half on positive indices; PF2 is preserved, masses decrease strictly, and the sharpened coefficient envelope holds.

The abstract G020 package of positivity, half-mass normalization, strict mass decay, PF2 and the normalized envelope does not imply PF3; an exact counterexample has G006 margin -1271/2500. This does not decide PF3 for the actual coefficients of F.
Under SOH-C001 and the channel assumptions, all non-trivial zeros lie on Re(s)=1/2.
Under SOH-C004, all non-trivial zeros lie on Re(s)=1/2.
Under SOH-C005 and the standard Weil correspondence, all non-trivial zeros lie on Re(s)=1/2.
Positivity of every finite Hermite section plus continuity extends non-negativity to the dense core.
The 18-pair detector is a low-height quadrature approximation to xi(s).
A declared synthetic off-axis quartet produces a negative minimum eigenvalue in the two-channel Gaussian probe.
The declared prime-side matrix is stable between tested prime cutoffs and matches the low-height spectral receipt.
The finite Hermite ladder through basis size six is cutoff-audited and PSD-tested.
For w=0.8, Q=100000 and N<=6, the largest certified prime-tail norm bound is 7.717202888999335e-13.
For the declared adaptive schedule through N<=20, all sharp tail certificates pass 1e-12; the maximum is 3.280365246530569e-14 at N=5.
Reciprocal symmetry alone does not force the self-dual point to be a global maximum in the declared Stage-M universe.
